<template>
  <v-container fluid>
    <v-card class="mb-4">
      <v-card-text>
        <v-row align="center">
          <v-col cols="12" sm="6" md="2">
            <v-select
              v-model="selectedAssetTypes"
              :items="assetTypes"
              label="Asset Types"
              multiple
              chips
              dense
            ></v-select>
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="12" sm="6" md="2">
            <v-select
              v-model="selectedBroker"
              :items="brokers"
              label="Brokers"
              item-title="name"
              item-value="id"
              dense
            ></v-select>
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="12" sm="6" md="2">
            <v-select
              v-model="selectedSecurities"
              :items="securities"
              label="Securities"
              multiple
              chips
              item-title="name"
              item-value="id"
              dense
            ></v-select>
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="12" sm="6" md="2">
            <v-text-field
              v-model="startDate"
              label="Start Date"
              type="date"
              dense
            ></v-text-field>
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="12" sm="6" md="2">
            <v-text-field
              v-model="endDate"
              label="End Date"
              type="date"
              dense
            ></v-text-field>
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="12" sm="6" md="2">
            <v-btn color="primary" @click="applyFilters" block>
              Apply Filters
            </v-btn>
          </v-col>
        </v-row>
      </v-card-text>
    </v-card>

    <v-card>
      <v-card-text>
        <v-row align="center" justify="space-between">
          <v-col cols="auto">
            <v-row>
              <v-col cols="auto">
                <AddSecurityButton />
              </v-col>
              <v-col cols="auto">
                <AddPriceEntryButton />
              </v-col>
            </v-row>
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="auto">
            <v-btn color="success" @click="showImportModal">
              Import Prices
            </v-btn>
          </v-col>
        </v-row>
      </v-card-text>
    </v-card>

    <!-- Price data table will be added here -->
  </v-container>
</template>

<script>
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { getAssetTypes, getBrokers, getSecurities } from '@/services/api';
import AddSecurityButton from '@/components/buttons/AddSecurity.vue';
import AddPriceEntryButton from '@/components/buttons/AddPrice.vue';

export default {
  name: 'PricesPage',
  components: {
    AddSecurityButton,
    AddPriceEntryButton,
  },
  setup() {
    const assetTypes = ref([]);
    const brokers = ref([]);
    const securities = ref([]);
    const selectedAssetTypes = ref([]);
    const selectedBroker = ref(null);
    const selectedSecurities = ref([]);
    const startDate = ref('');
    const endDate = ref('');

    onMounted(async () => {
      try {
        assetTypes.value = await getAssetTypes();
        brokers.value = await getBrokers();
        securities.value = await getSecurities();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching initial data:', error);
      }
    });

    const applyFilters = () => {
      // TODO: Implement filter application logic
      console.log('Applying filters');
    };

    const showImportModal = () => {
      // TODO: Implement import modal logic
      console.log('Showing import modal');
    };

    return {
      assetTypes,
      brokers,
      securities,
      selectedAssetTypes,
      selectedBroker,
      selectedSecurities,
      startDate,
      endDate,
      applyFilters,
      showImportModal,
      headers,
      priceData,
      loading,
      totalItems,
      itemsPerPage,
      editDialog,
      deleteDialog,
      editedItem,
      handleTableUpdate,
      editPrice,
      closeEditDialog,
      updatePrice,
      deletePrice,
      closeDeleteDialog,
      confirmDelete,
    };
  },
};
</script>
